AC: 1) Word-ngram candidate miner (1..3 words, within sentence boundaries) with stopword-edge pruning lands beside the untouched sentence-window _mine_tag_candidates; table-driven kept/rejected tests. 2) Importance scored unsupervised in vector space: salience (mean of top-m doc cosines) minus global-centroid cosine, then greedy substring/cosine dedup; FakeEmbedder oracle tests prove the expected ordering and hub suppression; pure python -- no numpy/umap/hdbscan/nltk. 3) Vocab persisted through the TodoStore abstraction on BOTH backends as a recomputable cache keyed by embedder + corpus fingerprint (sha256 of sorted Id:update_dt); stale or --refresh recomputes; deleting the cache is harmless. 4) 'todo terms [-n N] [--embedder=E] [--refresh]' prints global top terms and 'todo terms <selector>' ranks vocab terms against that ticket's doc vector; exactly one embedder per invocation. 5) Uses the EXISTING st registry entry (opt-in, hidden); CI uses hash/mock embedders and never downloads a model; the st integration test skips when sentence-transformers is absent. 6) SKILL.md documents the pipeline and explicitly distinguishes it from IDF/BM25 and from supervised fine-tuning. 7) Full todos test suite green; existing tag/search behavior unchanged.

Body.raw:
Build an unsupervised pipeline (not IDF/BM25, not supervised ST fine-tuning) that reads our documents and todo text, embeds chunks with sentence-transformers (or compatible dense embedder), and derives terms/phrases that are semantically important in vector space for our domain.

Context from design discussion:
- Hash embedder and lexical boosts are insufficient for semantic vocabulary discovery.
- sentence-transformers encode() is the engine only; importance scoring is our pipeline.
- NOT Apple Create ML / NLContextualEmbedding.
- NOT document-frequency IDF scores; importance means discriminative/salient in embedding geometry (e.g. term vectors aligned with doc/cluster centroids and far from global corpus centroid; KeyBERT-style doc-term cosine; cluster representatives after UMAP/HDBSCAN).

Relates to todo-embedding branch (sqlite + search) but this ticket is the separate semantic vocabulary layer: corpus ingest, candidate phrase mining, embed, score, persist term table, expose via todo.py (e.g. terms list / terms for doc / search boost hook).

Start after or alongside merging todo-embedding sqlite storage.

--- Curated tags -> embedding phrases (concept; NOT fleshed out here) ---
A curated tag names a bucket that expands to a list of embedding phrases, e.g.
  code-health -> ["test", "pytest", "iamlazy test", "playwright mcp", ...]
Auto-tagging matches a todo against these phrase lists (cosine) to assign tags.
Empirical note: an unspecialized general embedder (Apple NLCE) does NOT cleanly
rank such phrases -- compressed cosine range, keys on shared surface tokens over
concept (e.g. "technical debt" / "software quality" score BELOW distractors vs a
"code health" anchor). Motivates the domain-tuned importance pipeline above, not
a raw general embedder. Stop here for now.

--- Planned subtodo (subtask of this ticket): manual `todo tag` mechanism ---
Seeds the tag corpus, which starts EMPTY. Implementing agent wires the spawn +
wait-and-merge workitems; NOT spawned here.
`todo tag <id> <tag>*`:
- Manually add one or more tags to a todo. Additive; manual tags are NEVER
  auto-deleted.
- Tags surfaced in display: shown in `ls` and `search` output.
- Tags found by search: auto AND manual tags are embedded and become a THIRD
  cosine match target (alongside the Summary and Body vectors).
- Out of scope (later): grooming/bucketing tags and deriving the curated
  tag -> phrase lists that auto-tag todos.
- Manual tags are retained as regression backstops for the next tagging-training
  phase.

--- GROOMED DESIGN (2026-07-29) -- read this before coding ---

Code recon findings (what ALREADY exists -- do not rebuild):
- ST embedder: todo_embed.py SentenceTransformerEmbedder (all-MiniLM-L6-v2,
  normalize_embeddings=True) is registered as key "st" in _BACKENDS (hidden,
  opt-in, lazy import). The AC's "dense embedder" item is DONE; select it with
  --embedder=st. Do not add a new embedder.
- Vector plumbing: TodoStore (todo_store.py) persists per-field chunk vectors
  on BOTH backends (inline in ticket JSON; sqlite adds a derived embeddings
  index -- see has_vector_index). all_embeddings/put_embedding/
  embeddings_for_ticket are the API. search_tickets backfills missing vectors
  for non-cheap embedders at search time ("refreshing embeddings...") --
  REUSE that backfill path for doc vectors; never re-embed ad hoc.
- Mining today is SENTENCE-window granularity: _split_phrases +
  _nphrase_windows(_MAX_NPHRASE=3) yield 1..3-SENTENCE windows;
  _mine_tag_candidates dedups/downcases them. That is why auto-tag candidates
  are often whole sentences. Word-level term mining is NEW work. Leave
  _mine_tag_candidates untouched (doctor's auto-tagger consumes it).
- There is NO stopword machinery anywhere yet (ef4ad78d deferred "linguistic
  pruning" -- this ticket delivers it for the vocab miner).
- Everything numeric is pure python (cosine_similarity in todo_embed.py).
  Keep it that way: NO numpy/umap/hdbscan/nltk deps. Corpus is tens of
  tickets; O(terms x docs) loops are fine.

Design decisions (the wisdom -- implementor should not relitigate):
1. Candidate miner: word-ngram (1..3 words) windows WITHIN _split_phrases
   boundaries (ngrams never cross a sentence/line break), downcased.
   Prune: window whose first or last token is a stopword (builtin ~50-word
   frozenset _STOPWORDS, module-level, no external dep); all-stopword or
   all-digit windows; tokens < 2 chars; windows > 40 chars. Return
   {term: set(source ticket Ids)} so provenance rides along.
2. Doc vector per ticket: mean of its stored Summary/Body chunk vectors,
   then l2-normalize. One unit vector per ticket Id.
3. Importance scoring (centroid contrast -- implements "aligned with doc
   centroids, far from global corpus centroid" from the original body):
     c            = l2-normalized mean of all doc vectors
     salience(t)  = mean of top-m cos(v_t, d), m = min(3, ndocs)
     importance(t)= salience(t) - cos(v_t, c)
   The centroid subtraction IS the first-order hubness correction (a hub
   term scores high against everything INCLUDING c, so it cancels). This
   closes ef4ad78d's deferred hubness item. Escalate to CSLS only if hubs
   demonstrably persist -- not in v1.
4. Diversity: greedy dedup walking terms by descending importance; drop a
   term if it is a substring of a kept term (or vice versa) or cos > 0.85
   to any kept term's vector. Full MMR is overkill.
5. Persistence: a RECOMPUTABLE CACHE, never part of ticket records.
   TodoStore.get_vocab(embedder)/put_vocab(embedder, payload); sqlite gets a
   vocab table, dir backend gets vocab/<embedder>.json under the todo dir.
   payload = {corpus_fingerprint, computed_at, terms: [{term, score,
   sources}]} where corpus_fingerprint = sha256 over sorted "Id:update_dt"
   lines. Stale (fingerprint mismatch) or --refresh -> recompute. Deleting
   the cache must always be harmless.
6. CLI: `todo terms [-n N] [--embedder=E] [--refresh]` prints global top
   terms (score, term, #sources); `todo terms <selector>` ranks vocab terms
   by cosine to that ticket's doc vector (KeyBERT-style). ONE embedder per
   invocation (error on a comma list -- term scores do not fuse across
   vector spaces). Default embedder: hash (runs everywhere, CI-safe); docs
   say "use --embedder=st for real semantics". Follow the existing
   subcommand table pattern (~line 2500 in todo.py).
7. Empirical guardrail (from the design discussion above): Apple NLCE ranks
   concept phrases poorly (compressed cosine range, surface-token bias).
   Do not eyeball-validate the pipeline with apple; use st.

Out of scope for THIS ticket (file follow-ups instead):
- UMAP/HDBSCAN clustering (drop the cluster column idea; add nothing).
- Search boost hook (search behavior must not change under anyone's feet).
- Swapping doctor's auto-tag candidate domain to top-N vocab terms -- that
  is the eventual payoff, but it changes just-shipped ee1799aa behavior;
  separate ticket after vocab quality is eyeballed.

Testing strategy (matches the house oracle-test pattern from ee1799aa):
- Miner: table-driven kept/rejected oracle (e.g. "semantic tagging" kept;
  "the semantic tagging" rejected on stopword edge; "3 5" rejected).
- Scoring: hand-built FakeEmbedder in tests with a fixed {text: vector}
  dict whose geometry PROVES the expected ordering: a cluster-aligned term
  outranks a hub term near the centroid; near-duplicate terms collapse in
  dedup. MockEmbedder (sha256) is fine for plumbing but semantically
  meaningless -- do not assert rankings with it.
- Persistence: both backends, staleness on fingerprint change.
- CI never downloads a model: st integration test is skipped when
  sentence-transformers is absent (same pattern as the apple embedder
  tests). Full existing suite must stay green -- tag/search behavior is
  unchanged by this ticket.
